title: Your story is not over.
paragraphs:
Your story is not over.
God is still writing it.
Some chapters of life feel confusing.

Doors close.
Prayers seem unanswered.
The future feels uncertain.
But God is not finished with your story.

Even in seasons you don't understand,
He is still working behind the scenes.

You are not forgotten.
You are part of His plan.
"For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord… — Jeremiah 29:11
